parameter.name: address
parameter.label: Read Address
parameter.description: Zero-based address inside the poll window. Numeric sub-register values may use X.Y notation.

parameter.name: valueType
parameter.label: Value Type
parameter.description: Numeric decoder type, bit for coils/discrete inputs, or raw for String channels.

parameter.name: length
parameter.label: Raw Register Count
parameter.description: Number of registers for a raw String channel.

parameter.name: writeStart
parameter.label: Write Address
parameter.description: Optional zero-based write address. Holding-register bits use X.Y notation.

parameter.name: writeValueType
parameter.label: Write Value Type
parameter.description: Numeric encoder type, or bit for coil and holding-register bit writes.
